justification: Both surfaces depict schematic anthropomorphic figures with limbs rendered as simple lines, and both include circular elements (a prominent disc on the statue's torso, a small circle between the figures in B). But A is a single massive frontal figure whose body carries an assemblage of relief motifs (headdress bands, curled/scroll forms, a central disc, chevron bands), while B shows a horizontal row of multiple stick-like figures linked arm-to-arm across the surface, so the compositional schemes and figure conventions have little in common beyond the universally generic."}
